name: @plotday/web
env_vars: SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_ANON_KEY SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY SENTRY_DSN SENTRY_ORG SENTRY_PROJECT SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID GOOGLE_OAUTH_SECRET MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID MICROSOFT_OAUTH_SECRET

scripts.set-version: mkdir -p build && echo export const VERSION = \"$VERSION\" > build/version.ts
scripts.build: export VERSION=$CF_PAGES_COMMIT_SHA && pnpm run set-version && remix build --sourcemap && pnpm upload-source-map-server && pnpm upload-source-map-browser && pnpm delete-source-map
scripts.upload-source-map-server: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && wrangler pages functions build --outdir bundled-functions --sourcemap && sentry-cli sourcemaps inject bundled-functions && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release=$VERSION --dist=server bundled-functions && rm -rf bundled-functions
scripts.upload-source-map-browser: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && sentry-cli sourcemaps inject public && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release=$VERSION --dist=browser public
scripts.dev: export VERSION=development && pnpm run set-version && pnpm run dev:config && pnpm run dev:start
scripts.dev:start: export WORKERS_ENV=development && remix dev --manual -c "pnpm run dev:wrangler"
scripts.lint: export VERSION=lint && pnpm set-version && tsc && eslint .
